newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil products mostly up on brief crude strengt.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil products mostly up on brief crude strengt.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday with crude's afternoon strength boosting gasoline and low sulphur fuel, traders said.
Gasoline was firmer as crude futures reversed recent losses. Eurograde barges traded between $206 to $207.75 fob ARA throughout the day.
Naphtha was steady with a 14,000-tonne Russian cargo trading at $184 cif Rotterdam for pre-end May delivery.
A tight diesel market drew a cargo from the Med, but heating oil premiums eased with German buying weak.
High sulphur fuel oil dipped $1 on selling by one major, losing support it gained earlier from bunker demand. Low sulphur swaps were boosted by higher crude.
